title: Mielle kicks off second season as NFL’s Official Textured Hair Care Partner
summary: Hair care brand Mielle adds Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and Houston Texans defensive end Will Anderson Jr. to its NFL roster as it builds on its existing partnership with the American football league

extraction.key_fact: 헤어 케어 브랜드 미엘이 미국 미식축구 리그와의 공식 파트너십을 이어가며 선수들을 라인업에 추가했다.
